verdicts.reason: The two candidates look the same. Each is the original scaled down as one block and placed mid-canvas, leaving a plain empty band at the top (~110 px) and a larger one at the bottom (~130 px). The circle pattern stops sharply at about y=640, so the background looks cut off. The address text is tiny next to the date, and the layout was not rearranged for the taller format. The only difference is that the date/time line in B sits about 3 px tighter, which changes nothing.
